input.text: § 22 Absatz 1 des Allgemeinen Gleichbehandlungsgesetzes gilt entsprechend.

_note: 'des Allgemeinen Gleichbehandlungsgesetzes' must resolve to the FULL name 'Allgemeines Gleichbehandlungsgesetz', not be missed entirely (the compound suffix 'gesetzes' is fused, lower-case, mid-word -- it needs an adjective+fused-compound alternative, not only the standalone-suffix-word (b) alternative). The trailing 'gilt entsprechend' stays OUTSIDE the literal (supplement Sec3).
